description: A React component named DetailsViewer that renders detailed views of objects, supporting collapsible sections, formatting of known fields, raw JSON toggle, and copy-to-clipboard functionality.

methods.name: safePretty
methods.description: Returns a JSON string of the payload with fallback to string conversion, or a default message if rendering fails.

methods.name: toLabel
methods.description: Formats a key into a user-friendly label using formatLabel utility.

methods.name: isTimestampLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles a timestamp field based on regex.

methods.name: isTokenLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles a token count field based on regex.

methods.name: isDurationLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles a duration or latency field based on regex.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Converts a numeric value into a human-readable duration string, handling seconds and milliseconds.

methods.name: isCurrencyKeyLoose
methods.description: Determines if a key name loosely indicates a currency or cost field.

methods.name: formatValueByKey
methods.description: Formats a value based on its key, applying special formatting for currency, tokens, timestamps, durations, or numbers.

methods.name: initialCollapsed
methods.description: Decides if a section should be collapsed based on its depth and collapsedDepth prop.

methods.name: Collapser
methods.description: A React component that renders a collapsible section with toggle button.

methods.name: renderPrimitiveVal
methods.description: Renders a primitive value with appropriate styling and formatting.

methods.name: extractAgentIdentity
methods.description: Extracts agent ID and name from an object if available.

methods.name: renderNode
methods.description: Recursively renders a node (object, array, primitive) with collapsible sections for nested objects/arrays.

methods.name: renderEntries
methods.description: Renders key-value entries of an object, with highlighted keys first and collapsible sections.
